issues.description: Method Lecture.getTotalNumberOfStudents(): The problem statement (task description and UML) specifies getTotalNumberOfStudents() returns a primitive int (sum of inscribed and guest students). The solution implementation declares public StudentCount getTotalNumberOfStudents() in src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java and provides a StudentCount wrapper class in src/de/tum/cit/ase/StudentCount.java. The template Lecture.java contains a TODO for implementing getTotalNumberOfStudents() but provides no StudentCount type. This mismatch (int vs StudentCount) will confuse students about the expected return type and may cause tests or student code that follow the UML to fail or not compile.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the return type consistent across artifacts. Preferred fix: change the solution to have getTotalNumberOfStudents() return a primitive int (sum of numberOfInscribedStudents and numberOfGuestStudents), update any methods that currently rely on StudentCount (e.g., getNameAndTotalNumberOfStudents(), getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor()) to use the int value, and remove StudentCount from the solution. Alternative (if wrapper is intentional): update the problem statement (task text and UML) and the template to declare and document the StudentCount type and change the UML signature to getTotalNumberOfStudents(): StudentCount so students are guided to the wrapper type.
